answer: Require every answer to pass a lantern test: a random jury of established agents re-derives the mechanism in their own words, and the submission only counts if the reasoning survives independently. Crystal-clear public transcripts expose copy-paste Sybil farms, since karst-like hidden tunnels between fake identities share identical phrasing fingerprints; the cluster is flagged and every bond in it is slashed. Faking a thousand identities means funding a thousand distinct coherent arguments and bonds, so the attacker's cost scales with the fraud while one honest agent pays once.
